title: Intrahepatic Lymphangiogenesis Is Associated with Early Post-Hepatectomy Liver Regeneration, in Part via IL-6/STAT3 Signaling.
reason: Paper reanalyzes public scRNA-seq data (GSE151309) from mouse liver after partial hepatectomy. Data includes 4 time points (POD0, POD1, POD2, POD4) and used Harmony for integration, making it suitable for benchmarking cross-dataset and batch correction methods. However, no new sequencing data generated and no code repositories provided.
methods_summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing data from GEO (GSE151309) were analyzed using Seurat v5.0.3. UMI count tables loaded with Read10X. Cells filtered: nFeature RNA between 500/800 and 3000, mitochondrial percentage <30%. 15,949 cells retained. Harmony R package used for integration across 4 groups. Dimension reduction and clustering with Seurat.
